compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD2: ci-generator.sh gains --mode=pr-protected variant; generated workflow includes Resolve-and-fetch DSO plugin assets step; validate-required-checks.sh referenced in a run: block

## Implementation

Files:
- plugins/dso/scripts/onboarding/ci-generator.sh (modify — add --mode flag parsing and pr-protected template branch)
- plugins/dso/skills/shared/prompts/ci-skeleton-templates.md (modify — add PR-mode template section)

1. Add --mode=pr-protected flag parsing to ci-generator.sh (alongside existing --mode=standard if present, or add new argument parsing)
2. When --mode=pr-protected: generate CI workflow YAML that includes:
   a. A job step named "Resolve and fetch DSO plugin assets" (same step used in CI parity epic for fetching the DSO plugin from the marketplace)
   b. A `run:` block invoking `bash validate-required-checks.sh` (or path equivalent)
3. Add corresponding pr-protected template section to ci-skeleton-templates.md documenting the variant

After implementation, Task 2a's test_mode_pr_protected_generates_resolve_fetch_step must turn GREEN.

## TDD Requirement
Depends on Task 2a (which wrote the RED test). Implement until the RED test passes GREEN.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] test_mode_pr_protected_generates_resolve_fetch_step passes GREEN
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-ci-generator.sh 2>&1 | grep -q 'test_mode_pr_protected_generates_resolve_fetch_step.*PASS'
- [ ] Generated YAML has validate-required-checks.sh in a run: block
  Verify: (covered by test above — test asserts run: block specifically)
- [ ] ci-skeleton-templates.md contains PR-mode template section
  Verify: grep -q 'pr.protected\|pr_protected' plugins/dso/skills/shared/prompts/ci-skeleton-templates.md
- [ ] Lint passes
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Format passes
  Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet->opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
